title: A filled rectangle and a filled oval
concept: Rectangle and Oval as pure vector frames: a FillColor swatch makes each shape paint without any text or image content.

annotations.note: A Rectangle with FillColor="Color/Red". With no story and no image it is a plain vector shape; its four corner anchors make the rectangle.
An Oval with FillColor="Color/Blue". An Oval is drawn from its path, like any other shape.

The path InDesign writes for an ellipse: four anchors at the edge midpoints (bottom, right, top, left), each with handles 0.5523 × the radius along its edge. Here the radius is 120, so this is a circle. Four corner anchors under an Oval would draw a square.
